heading: Regulations
lead: The Office of Personnel Management shall prescribe regulations to carry out the purpose of this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 4705, added Pub. L. 95–454, title VI, § 601(a), Oct. 13, 1978, 92 Stat. 1188, required annual report on research programs and demonstration projects, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 105–362, title XIII, § 1302(b)(2)(B)(i), Nov. 10, 1998, 112 Stat. 3293.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 90 days after Oct. 13, 1978, see section 907 of Pub. L. 95–454, set out as an Effective Date of 1978 Amendment note under section 1101 of this title.

ancestors.heading: PERSONNEL RESEARCH PROGRAMS AND DEMONSTRATION PROJECTS
